chunk-001:c004.proposition: Evolutionary naturalism threatens confidence in human reasoning because survival-oriented, mindless processes do not necessarily select for truth, thereby undermining the rationality presupposed by science.

orphanFallback.rationale: Independently of any earlier opposing move, the excerpt advances a source-grounded objection to naturalism's ability to warrant confidence in truth-directed human reasoning.

chunk-001:c006.proposition: Discovering natural mechanisms does not eliminate God because explanation by a creator as agent operates at a different level from scientific explanation of how natural processes work.

orphanFallback.rationale: The Newton-and-gravity distinction independently establishes the compatibility of scientific mechanisms with creator agency without requiring the earlier analogy it answers.

chunk-001:c007.proposition: The information-processing language and digital database of life are more intelligible as products of mind than as products of unguided matter and random natural processes.

orphanFallback.rationale: The excerpt supplies a positive design inference from cellular information processing to mind, so its argumentative content remains intelligible without an earlier opposing move.

orphanFallback.rationale: The stated expectation-and-evidence inference is a positive theistic argument from intelligibility and fine-tuning that stands independently of the preceding gap accusation.

orphanFallback.rationale: The excerpt independently reasons from pervasive unresolved injustice to the significance of resurrection and final justice, even without the earlier dispute over atonement.
